nodes.name: history.rs
nodes.summary: Rust-native session history querying: filtering, sorting, grouping, and pagination of session records, replacing a large TypeScript useSessionHistory hook implementation (~486 lines of filter/reduce/sort).

nodes.name: query_sessions
nodes.summary: Filters, sorts, and paginates the full session record list according to a HistoryQuery, returning matched sessions with running/completed/failed counts.

nodes.name: get_recent_sessions
nodes.summary: Returns the most recently updated sessions, bounded by a count limit.

nodes.name: group_sessions
nodes.summary: Groups a list of sessions by a date bucket (today/yesterday/this week/etc.) for grouped history display.

nodes.name: format_group_label
nodes.summary: Formats a date-group key into a human-readable label such as 'Today' or 'Last 7 Days'.

nodes.name: SessionRecord
nodes.summary: Serializable snapshot of a single agent session's metadata (status, repo, timestamps, model, event/file-change counts) used for history views.

nodes.name: HistoryQuery
nodes.summary: Query parameters (status/type/repo filters, search text, sort, pagination offset/limit) accepted by the session-history query function.

nodes.name: consolidator.rs
nodes.summary: Merges streaming thinking/message delta chunks into single consolidated events during ingestion; a Rust port of the TypeScript consolidateChunks logic using dual accumulators to handle interleaved thinking+message streams.

nodes.name: consolidate_activity_chunks
nodes.summary: Consolidates a raw stream of activity chunks into merged events, accumulating and flushing thinking/message deltas at boundaries.

nodes.name: is_message_delta
nodes.summary: Determines whether a chunk represents an incremental assistant-message delta.

nodes.name: is_legacy_assistant_delta
nodes.summary: Detects legacy-format assistant message delta chunks predating the current delta schema.

nodes.name: is_thinking_end_marker
nodes.summary: Detects a chunk that marks the end of a thinking/reasoning stream.

nodes.name: is_complete_message
nodes.summary: Determines whether a chunk represents a complete (non-delta) assistant message.

nodes.name: is_empty_chunk
nodes.summary: Determines whether a chunk carries no meaningful content and should be filtered out during consolidation.

nodes.name: has_thinking_text
nodes.summary: Checks whether an accumulated thinking buffer contains non-empty text.

nodes.name: extract_thinking_content
nodes.summary: Extracts the thinking/reasoning text content from a chunk.

nodes.name: extract_message_content
nodes.summary: Extracts the assistant-message text content from a chunk.

nodes.name: dedup_assistant_messages
nodes.summary: Removes duplicate consecutive assistant messages produced by overlapping stream chunks.

nodes.name: function_map.rs
nodes.summary: Normalizes raw tool/function names from CLI agent chunks into canonical storage names, delegating to the shared `cli_agents::alias_map` single source of truth for consistency with UI routing.

nodes.name: resolve_function_name
nodes.summary: Resolves a raw tool/function name (and optional CLI agent context) to its canonical database storage name via the shared alias map.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Entry point for the event ingestion pipeline; orchestrates consolidation, normalization, tool-call merging, and prompt backfill to turn raw activity chunks into SessionEvents.

nodes.name: ingest_raw_chunks_with_prompt_resolver
nodes.summary: Runs the full ingestion pipeline (consolidate, normalize, merge tool calls, backfill subagent prompts) using a caller-supplied prompt resolver.

nodes.name: normalizer.rs
nodes.summary: Converts raw RawActivityChunk records into normalized SessionEvent objects, inferring display variant/status/text and extracting structured metadata (file path, command, call id); a Rust port of the TypeScript normalizers.ts.

nodes.name: normalize_chunk
nodes.summary: Converts a single RawActivityChunk into a SessionEvent, resolving the canonical function name and computing display metadata.

nodes.name: normalize_chunks
nodes.summary: Normalizes a batch of RawActivityChunks into SessionEvents by mapping normalize_chunk over the collection.

nodes.name: infer_display_variant
nodes.summary: Infers which UI display variant (tool_call, message, thinking, etc.) a chunk should render as.

nodes.name: infer_display_status
nodes.summary: Infers the display status (running/completed/failed/etc.) of a chunk from its action type and result.

nodes.name: is_ask_question_action
nodes.summary: Determines whether a chunk represents an interactive ask-question action requiring user input.

nodes.name: has_non_empty_result
nodes.summary: Checks whether a chunk's result payload contains meaningful (non-empty) data.

nodes.name: infer_activity_status
nodes.summary: Maps a chunk's raw status/result into the canonical ActivityStatus enum.

nodes.name: infer_display_text
nodes.summary: Derives the human-readable display text/preview shown for an event from its chunk content and function type.

nodes.name: raw_message_text
nodes.summary: Extracts the raw, unprocessed message text from a chunk.

nodes.name: extract_text_content
nodes.summary: Extracts and concatenates text content blocks from a chunk's message/result payload.

nodes.name: strip_terminal_code_blocks
nodes.summary: Strips wrapping markdown code-fence syntax from terminal/shell output text.

nodes.name: extract_args
nodes.summary: Extracts the raw args JSON value from a chunk, defaulting to an empty object.

nodes.name: extract_file_path
nodes.summary: Extracts a file path from a chunk's args across several possible field name variants.

nodes.name: extract_call_id
nodes.summary: Extracts the tool-call correlation id from a chunk's args or metadata.

nodes.name: prompt_backfill.rs
nodes.summary: Heuristics for finding and backfilling a meaningful subagent delegation prompt when the original prompt was generic, redacted, or missing, enriching subagent-spawn events after ingestion.

nodes.name: strip_known_prompt_prelude
nodes.summary: Strips known boilerplate prelude text from a subagent prompt before further analysis.

nodes.name: prompt_from_history_chunks
nodes.summary: Searches a session's prior history chunks for the earliest usable, non-generic subagent prompt.

nodes.name: backfill_subagent_prompts_with_resolver
nodes.summary: Backfills generic/placeholder subagent prompts in a batch of session events with better prompts resolved via a caller-supplied history resolver.

nodes.name: tool_call_merger.rs
nodes.summary: Merges tool_call start (with args) and end (with result) chunk pairs sharing the same call_id into single unified events, for cases where historical/imported data splits a tool call across separate stream events.

nodes.name: merge_tool_call_pairs
nodes.summary: Scans a chunk list and merges matching tool_call start/end pairs by call_id into single combined events.

nodes.name: is_tool_call_event
nodes.summary: Determines whether a chunk represents any kind of tool_call event.

nodes.name: is_tool_call_start
nodes.summary: Determines whether a chunk is the 'start' half of a split tool_call pair.

nodes.name: is_tool_call_end
nodes.summary: Determines whether a chunk is the 'end' half of a split tool_call pair.

nodes.name: merge_start_end
nodes.summary: Combines a matched tool_call start and end chunk into a single merged event carrying both args and result.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the raw activity-chunk input type (mirroring the TypeScript ActivityChunk interface) and the IngestionResult summary type produced by the ingestion pipeline.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Root module for the agent-session event pipeline; wires together ingestion, storage, extractors, search, pagination, statistics, and streaming submodules for the full raw-chunk-to-UI event lifecycle.
